propositions.name: natural_selection_defined
propositions.quote: This preservation of favourable variations and the rejection of injurious variations, I call Natural Selection.
propositions.statement: Natural Selection is the preservation of favourable variations and the rejection of injurious variations.

propositions.name: more_born_than_survive
propositions.quote: (remembering that many more individuals are born than can possibly survive)
propositions.statement: Many more individuals are born than can possibly survive.

propositions.name: slight_advantage_best_chance
propositions.quote: individuals having any advantage, however slight, over others, would have the best chance of surviving and of procreating their kind
propositions.statement: Individuals having any advantage, however slight, over others would have the best chance of surviving and procreating their kind.

propositions.name: injurious_variation_destroyed
propositions.quote: we may feel sure that any variation in the least degree injurious would be rigidly destroyed
propositions.statement: Any variation in the least degree injurious would be rigidly destroyed.

propositions.name: conditions_change_causes_variability
propositions.quote: a change in the conditions of life, by specially acting on the reproductive system, causes or increases variability
propositions.statement: A change in the conditions of life, by acting on the reproductive system, causes or increases variability.

propositions.name: nature_longer_time_than_man
propositions.quote: as man can certainly produce great results by adding up in any given direction mere individual differences, so could Nature, but far more easily, from having incomparably longer time at her disposal
propositions.statement: Nature can produce great results from mere individual differences from having incomparably longer time at her disposal than man.

propositions.name: nature_acts_on_internals
propositions.quote: She can act on every internal organ, on every shade of constitutional difference, on the whole machinery of life
propositions.statement: Nature can act on every internal organ and every shade of constitutional difference.

propositions.name: nature_selects_for_beings_good
propositions.quote: Man selects only for his own good; Nature only for that of the being which she tends
propositions.statement: Nature selects only for the good of the being which she tends.

propositions.name: selection_scrutinises_daily
propositions.quote: natural selection is daily and hourly scrutinising, throughout the world, every variation, even the slightest; rejecting that which is bad, preserving and adding up all that is good
propositions.statement: Natural selection is daily and hourly scrutinising every variation, rejecting the bad and preserving the good.

propositions.name: no_modification_for_other_species
propositions.quote: What natural selection cannot do, is to modify the structure of one species, without giving it any advantage, for the good of another species
propositions.statement: Natural selection cannot modify the structure of one species without giving it any advantage, for the good of another species.

propositions.name: correlation_of_growth
propositions.quote: there are many unknown laws of correlation of growth, which, when one part of the organisation is modified through variation, and the modifications are accumulated by natural selection for the good of the being, will cause other modifications
propositions.statement: There are many unknown laws of correlation of growth by which modification of one part causes other modifications.

propositions.name: inheritance_at_corresponding_age
propositions.quote: those variations which under domestication appear at any particular period of life, tend to reappear in the offspring at the same period
propositions.statement: Variations that appear at a particular period of life tend to reappear in the offspring at the same period.

propositions.name: sexual_selection_defined
propositions.quote: This depends, not on a struggle for existence, but on a struggle between the males for possession of the females; the result is not death to the unsuccessful competitor, but few or no offspring
propositions.statement: Sexual selection depends on a struggle between the males for possession of the females; the result is few or no offspring, not death.

propositions.name: female_choice_produces_effect
propositions.quote: female birds, by selecting, during thousands of generations, the most melodious or beautiful males, according to their standard of beauty, might produce a marked effect
propositions.statement: Female birds selecting the most melodious or beautiful males across thousands of generations might produce a marked effect.

propositions.name: selection_infinitesimal_modifications
propositions.quote: Natural selection can act only by the preservation and accumulation of infinitesimally small inherited modifications, each profitable to the preserved being
propositions.statement: Natural selection acts only by the preservation and accumulation of infinitesimally small inherited modifications, each profitable to the preserved being.

propositions.name: banishes_continued_creation
propositions.quote: so will natural selection, if it be a true principle, banish the belief of the continued creation of new organic beings, or of any great and sudden modification in their structure
propositions.statement: Natural selection, if a true principle, will banish the belief of the continued creation of new organic beings or of any great and sudden modification.

propositions.name: cross_gives_vigour
propositions.quote: a cross between different varieties, or between individuals of the same variety but of another strain, gives vigour and fertility to the offspring; and on the other hand, that close interbreeding diminishes vigour and fertility
propositions.statement: A cross between different varieties or strains gives vigour and fertility to the offspring; close interbreeding diminishes vigour and fertility.

propositions.name: no_perpetual_self_fertilisation
propositions.quote: no organic being self-fertilises itself for an eternity of generations; but that a cross with another individual is occasionally—perhaps at very long intervals—indispensable
propositions.statement: No organic being self-fertilises itself for an eternity of generations; a cross with another individual is occasionally indispensable.

propositions.name: isolation_important
propositions.quote: Isolation, also, is an important element in the process of natural selection
propositions.statement: Isolation is an important element in the process of natural selection.

propositions.name: closely_allied_forms_compete
propositions.quote: it is the most closely-allied forms,—varieties of the same species, and species of the same genus or of related genera,—which, from having nearly the same structure, constitution, and habits, generally come into the severest competition with each other
propositions.statement: The most closely-allied forms come into the severest competition with each other.

propositions.name: varieties_are_incipient_species
propositions.quote: according to my view, varieties are species in the process of formation, or are, as I have called them, incipient species
propositions.statement: Varieties are species in the process of formation, or incipient species.

propositions.name: divergence_of_character
propositions.quote: the more diversified the descendants from any one species become in structure, constitution, and habits, by so much will they be better enabled to seize on many and widely diversified places in the polity of nature
propositions.statement: The more diversified the descendants from any one species become, the better enabled they will be to seize places in the polity of nature.

propositions.name: physiological_division_of_labour
propositions.quote: The advantage of diversification in the inhabitants of the same region is, in fact, the same as that of the physiological division of labour in the organs of the same individual body
propositions.statement: The advantage of diversification is the same as that of the physiological division of labour in the organs of the same individual body.

propositions.name: common_species_vary_more
propositions.quote: the species, which are the commonest and the most widely-diffused, vary more than rare species with restricted ranges
propositions.statement: The species which are commonest and most widely-diffused vary more than rare species with restricted ranges.

propositions.name: descent_from_common_parent
propositions.quote: Action of Natural Selection, through Divergence of Character and Extinction, on the descendants from a common parent
propositions.statement: Natural selection acts through divergence of character and extinction on the descendants from a common parent.

propositions.name: new_species_replace_old
propositions.quote: as new species in the course of time are formed through natural selection, others will become rarer and rarer, and finally extinct
propositions.statement: As new species are formed through natural selection, others will become rarer and finally extinct.

propositions.name: offspring_inherit_habits
propositions.quote: Some of its young would probably inherit the same habits or structure, and by the repetition of this process, a new variety might be formed
propositions.statement: Some young inherit the habits or structure of their parents, and by repetition a new variety might be formed.

propositions.name: mutual_relations_complex
propositions.quote: how infinitely complex and close-fitting are the mutual relations of all organic beings to each other and to their physical conditions of life
propositions.statement: The mutual relations of all organic beings to each other and to their physical conditions of life are infinitely complex and close-fitting.
